VALID-01.name: Match the analytical task to field meaning
VALID-01.requirement: A finite operation accepts only its declared semantic roles and complete distinct fields.

SOURCE-01.name: Keep the marks attached to their evidence
SOURCE-01.requirement: Chart, observation, table and replay consume the same result artifact; selection uses exact series/index mappings.

SUPPORT-01.name: Expose support and missing information
SUPPORT-01.requirement: Show the recorded support, missing values, sample status and omitted groups. Group comparisons need declared minimum support.

SCALE-01.name: Use a scale appropriate to the comparison
SCALE-01.requirement: Magnitude bars include zero; log ordinates require positive values; proportions use a declared domain; temporal gaps stay missing.

ORDER-01.name: Preserve meaningful category order
ORDER-01.requirement: Declared ordinal order takes precedence over a frequency ranking.

AGG-01.name: Show what a summary leaves out
AGG-01.requirement: Means are paired with support or distribution views. Bin and period comparisons are diagnostic views, not automatic robustness verdicts.

MODEL-01.name: Evaluate on held-out rows
MODEL-01.requirement: Train-only preprocessing, fixed baselines, explicit memberships and source-linked errors precede any model-derived finding. Prediction does not establish causality.

HYPOTHESIS-01.name: Compute before interpreting a visual hypothesis
HYPOTHESIS-01.requirement: A model may propose an eligible check or abstain. Python executes it; generated prose remains labeled interpretation and cannot add measured quantities.

scope: The studies motivate conditional design patterns. Thresholds and budgets are engineering choices; this integrated app has not undergone a user study. Few's corpus is expert guidance, not one experimentally validated universal algorithm.
